top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a falsifiable prediction (spin-orbit coupling plus time-reversal symmetry giving a Z2 invariant with protected edge channels) tested by a decisive measurement of quantised edge conduction in HgTe wells, reproduced for about eighteen years by transport and photoemission in several material families. No member disputes the physics or maturity. The allocation is defensible if the citation stays anchored to the quantum spin Hall state and its first observation, leaving out Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang and Hasan and not claiming the whole topological-insulator class. That is better than no award.
